core.title: Nylon Sub-Rose Assembly for AHI Leversets

text.description_html:
Nylon Sub-Rose Assembly for AHI Stainless Steel Leversets

AHI nylon sub-rose assembly feature self-aligning thru-bolts and fits a standard 2-1/8" bore hole. Lever strength spring assisted inside and outside, for Door Levers only (Not for use with Door Knobs). For use with passage and privacy functions. Has a 8mm hub t

For use with AHI Stainless Steel Leversets Only.

  • Diameter: 2-7/16"
  • Projection: 1/2"
  • Fits standard 2-1/8" Bore Hole
  • 8mm Square Hub (for 8mm Square Spindle)
